result.summary: Тесты стали намного крепче: все 165 тестов (55 + 14 + 96) зелёные пять раз подряд, 11 охранных тестов красны на чистой копии метки, а из 195 моих мутантов (39 из проекта и около 150 своих) выжили только три настоящих, и все три - об одном правиле: шаблон со следующим за ним текстом. findings.what: The requirement says a template is the whole value (in quotes: the whole content) and that a template with text around it is a literal (examples p${x}w0rd and p<ss>w0rd). The tables hold only text BEFORE a group (C14: password: "p${x}w0rd" and "p{{x}}w0rd", "p<ss>w0rd") and nothing with text AFTER a group, in a quotation or in the password of an address. Two mutants of mine survived all seven files (0 red of 151, 106 s each; also the fast subset RB-07/08/09/20): i6_groupprefix - in findValue the quoted-value test findGroup(text, a, null, contentEnd) === contentEnd is changed to !== -1 (a quotation that merely STARTS with a group is a template); i6b_addr - the same in findUrlPassword (findGroup(text, a, null, j) === j to !== -1). A real secret glued behind a template in a quoted value or in the password of an address would be stored.
